entries.text: Key Numbers on stock pages now tell you whether a stock's P/E, profit margin, dividend, and volatility are high or low for its sector — with a "typical" marker on each meter and a plain-language note like "Cheaper than most Technology companies"
Added plain-language explanations across your portfolio and watchlist — hover a metric label like Unrealized P/L, Cost Basis, P/E, or a Financial Health category to see what it means
The Financial Health gauge is now easier to read — each category is colour-keyed to its slice of the ring and you can hover any category name for a plain explanation
Crypto and commodity pages now show the same visual stats as stocks, including a 24-hour range bar and plain-language takeaways
New to BullPen? A getting-started card now greets brand-new accounts with a few first steps, and disappears on its own once you get going
The Daily Brief now shows a mini price trend next to each featured stock
Financials charts (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow) are now colour-coded and animate in — the Balance Sheet shows what a company owns versus what it owes at a glance
The stock price chart is clearer and more accurate, and its indicator legend now shows a live value for each line as you move across the chart
The screener now falls back to the last known price when the market is closed, instead of showing blanks
Refreshed Ask Bull's starter prompts to show what it can really do — add a holding, set an alert, check insider activity — and removed ones that led to a broken tool
The Community page now features an Academy XP leaderboard
Fixed the Compare tool, and Ask Bull's company-metrics and company-comparison answers, which had stopped working after an underlying data source was retired
Fixed the activity heatmap's month labels drifting out of line with their columns, which could make a month look empty
Fixed the stock chart briefly looking empty at the very start of the trading day, before the first prices of the day come in
Fixed profile picture uploads failing to save
Ask Bull's answers are now much more visual — health scores, prices, key stats, financials, earnings, screener results, and more now show as charts and cards instead of plain text
Ask Bull can now check a stock's recent insider buying and selling activity
When you ask Bull to add, update, or remove a holding, or create a price alert, you'll now see a clear confirmation it worked — or a clear error with a retry button if it didn't

Stock pages got a big visual upgrade — Key Numbers, Earnings, Financials, and Insider Transactions now show as charts, meters, and range bars instead of plain tables, each with a plain-language takeaway
Fixed the Earnings section's "Recent Reports" almost always showing empty — past earnings now actually appear
You can now pin your favorite stocks and assets for quick access — pin from any stock page, then see their live prices anytime from a new button in the top navigation
The AI assistant got a friendlier new look and is now called Ask Bull, with a waving bull mascot welcoming you in
You can now hide individual cards inside Market Context on your dashboard, instead of having to remove the whole section
Highlighted terms in Academy lessons now open the full AI assistant when you ask for more, so you can keep asking follow-up questions
The 5-day stock chart now includes pre-market and after-hours price moves, so you always see the latest action
Fixed live prices sometimes failing to load on the screener, watchlist, heatmap, and stock pages
Fixed some valid stocks, like ExxonMobil, occasionally showing a "not found" page by mistake
Fixed the "Build your portfolio" prompt appearing on the wrong pages and for people who already have holdings
Ask Bull now remembers your past conversations — open the history icon in the chat panel to pick up where you left off
The Beyond Stocks: ETFs & Crypto Academy course can now be skipped if you're not interested, without blocking later courses
More Ask Bull polish: a bigger, easier-to-read chat icon, clearer status messages while it's working, and smoother text as answers come in
Ask Bull now shows a quick one-time screen the first time you chat, explaining how your messages are used
Sign-up now starts with a few quick questions about your investing experience, risk tolerance, timeframe, and goals — so the app and AI assistant feel tailored to you right away
You can now browse past Daily Briefs and step back and forth through them, so missing a morning doesn't mean missing the brief
Added four new Academy courses — Company Fundamentals, Building a Portfolio, Dividends & Passive Income, and Beyond Stocks: ETFs & Crypto
Renamed the Reading a Stock Price course to Why Stocks Move and refreshed its content so it no longer overlaps with Reading a Stock Quote
Simplified the holdings performance chart by removing the confusing "Since Purchase" timeframe, since MAX already showed the same numbers
Sped up the stock screener's live price updates
Fixed new dashboard widgets getting buried at the bottom if you'd already customized your homepage layout
Fixed the Academy lesson-complete celebration taking several seconds to appear, and made the bull mascot easier to see
Fixed the AI assistant occasionally showing a raw technical error message instead of a plain one when it hit a rate limit
Fixed recently-viewed stocks not updating for tickers not yet in our database
Fixed the Academy welcome banner popping up at the wrong time, and added a loading placeholder for the daily challenge
Fixed Financial Health scores occasionally showing different values on different pages for the same stock
Added a new Academy course, Reading a Stock Quote, covering price, bid/ask spreads, and trading volume
The Academy daily challenge is live again with a fresh question every day
Fixed Academy sending signed-out visitors straight to the sign-in page instead of showing what they'd be learning first
Fixed the Community "Browse Members" page showing no one when you weren't signed in
Fixed the "Why Today?" explanation showing a technical error message instead of a plain one when something went wrong
Added a Why Today widget to your dashboard — see the biggest mover in your holdings and watchlist at a glance, and ask why with one click
Fixed stock pages occasionally failing to load Financials or the Revenue Flow chart on first visit, and the Financial Health score not updating after a temporary data hiccup
Added a new interactive Academy course, Reading Charts, that walks you through reading a price chart step by step
The Financial Health score now tracks history over time, with a trend indicator and a chart showing how it's changed since the last earnings report
Added Norwegian as a supported language
Added a quick "Why?" button next to a stock's price that explains what's driving today's move, powered by AI with live web search
AI features across the app, including the AI assistant, now reply in your chosen language instead of always English
Fixed notifications occasionally showing implausible price swings, and made the wording clearer
Sped up API responses across the app by skipping an unnecessary network check on requests that didn't need it
Save and reuse your favorite dividend calculator setups, with a one-click option to fill it in from your holdings
Automatic brokerage account syncing is now a Pro feature; manually adding holdings or importing from CSV stays free for everyone
Fixed pre-market price changes sometimes showing as stuck at 0%
Added the BullPen logo throughout the app and as your browser tab icon
The AI assistant can now look up any company's Financial Health score and profile, even ones not yet in our database
Fixed financial health scores occasionally showing incorrect or missing data during high-traffic periods
